name: Chandni Chowk, the galis
notes: Lane widths change every few metres, so the generator reads width from the repaired road, not from this profile. Dead-end courtyards behind the lanes stay off the road graph (sheet 'Map notes').

buildings.ground_floor: shop below, home or store room above; raised thresholds at the doors
buildings.balconies: cantilever balconies and jharokhas stepping out so the sky is a thin strip; potted plants on the balconies
buildings.roofline: roofs with water tanks and dishes

gate_and_window_grilles.kind: rolled steel shutters, wooden doors, haveli iron gates and arched lane-mouth gates

footpath.surface: one worn surface of old stone, brick or patched concrete from shutter to shutter, stepped at shop thresholds, an open drain along one edge
footpath.notes: lane width 2.5 to 3.5 m for small galis, about 4 m for bazaar lanes, 5 to 6 m for Ballimaran and Katra Bariyan, 8 to 10 m for Khari Baoli and Chawri Bazar; shop spill takes 0.5 to 1.5 m each side

lamps.kind: bare bulbs, tube lights and string lights on shopfronts and awnings; a sodium bracket pole only at lane mouths

kinds: haveli iron gates and arched doorways
arches over lane mouths 3 to 4 m wide
tarpaulins and cloth awnings in blue, green and orange

signs.boards: hand-painted shop boards and hanging signs; blue and white street-name boards at the corners

life.people: porters with loads, shopkeepers on their thresholds, sweet and snack makers, shoppers of all ages and dress, schoolchildren, older residents sitting on steps; the lanes are busiest in the evening

sound.calls: vendor calls, frying and cooking noise, handcarts on stone

wear_notes: 0.9 in the wider market lanes (Khari Baoli, Chawri Bazar)

road.condition: patched concrete, old stone or asphalt with wet patches; no markings
